title: The Bahamas Welcomes First-Ever U.S. Nonstop Service to Bimini via American Airlines
summary: Nassau, The Bahamas, Feb. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — The Bahamas Ministry of Tourism, Investments & Aviation proudly announced a new era of connectivity for Bimini, welcoming the launch of the first-ever nonstop service from the United States via American Airlines.
